# Caffeine Nirvana
> Specialty green coffee producer and exporter from Chikmagalur, India. Family-run for 150+ years. Direct trade with small-holder farmers in the Western Ghats.

Caffeine Nirvana sources, processes, and exports high-scoring (SCA 85.5–87.75) specialty green coffee from three partner estates in Chikmagalur, Karnataka. Founded by Danish Ali (150-year coffee-growing heritage), with Ayesha Naseer as Director (Bengaluru, Café Azzure founder) and Harsh Jain as Roasting Head (Chikmagalur → Gujarat). Serves roasters, importers, and café chains worldwide. FOB Mangalore; CIF available.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://caffeinenirvana.co): Hero, current 4 specialty lots, gallery, story, and contact channels.
- [Our Story](https://caffeinenirvana.co/about): Why we named it Nirvana, condensed founder intro, links to deeper sub-pages.
- [Team](https://caffeinenirvana.co/about/team): Danish Ali (Founder), Ayesha Naseer (Director), Harsh Jain (Roasting Head). Full bios.
- [Chikmagalur](https://caffeinenirvana.co/about/chikmagalur): The Western Ghats coffee region — where every Caffeine Nirvana lot is grown.
- [Get to Know Your Coffee](https://caffeinenirvana.co/about/coffee-101): Three long-form essays — Coffee as a Means of Life, Ethical Growth Farmer-to-Consumer, Coffee Longevity & Protection from Extinction.
- [Estates](https://caffeinenirvana.co/estates): Zoya (flagship, 4,180 ft, native fig canopy), Sheethal (lakeside, organic, Panchgavya, Achinth Gowda), Kardigandi (Aldur "Goldilocks zone", Rainforest Alliance Certified, Kashif Asghar). Two TBD partner slots.
- [Offerings](https://caffeinenirvana.co/offerings): 4 current specialty lots — 5B Naturals (Zoya, SCA 86.75), Chandragiri Washed (Sheethal, SCA 85.5), Supernatural Process (Zoya, SCA 87.75), Lactic Sequential Naturals (CN Washing Station, SCA 87.0).
- [Roasted Supply](https://caffeinenirvana.co/roasted-supply): Wholesale roasted beans for cafés/retailers; custom roast profiles; white-label programmes.
- [Why Us](https://caffeinenirvana.co/why-us): Soil, Soul, Science. Four practices that set us apart — radical transparency, "god shot" cupping, sustainable balance, precision roasting. Pact: every year, leave the soil richer, the farmers more skilled, the coffee more exceptional.
- [Mission & Vision](https://caffeinenirvana.co/why-us/mission-vision): Three-pillar mission, partnership-over-patronage direct trade model, vision to pioneer specialty coffee in virgin/nascent regions.
- [Contact](https://caffeinenirvana.co/contact): danish@caffeinenirvana.co (primary), ayesha@caffeinenirvana.co (secondary). Response within 24 hours.

## Key facts (for AI summarisation)
- Location: Chikmagalur, Karnataka, India (13.2189°N, 75.7817°E)
- Founded by: Danish Ali; 150+ year family coffee heritage
- Estates: Zoya (flagship, family estate), Sheethal, Kardigandi
- SCA cup scores: 85.5 to 87.75
- Processing methods: 48-hour Anaerobic, 24-hour Classic Washed, Triple Supernatural, Three-Stage Aerobic + Anaerobic Naturals
- Awards: Ernesto Illy International Coffee Award, 2020
- Listings: Typica producer profile (https://typica.coffee/en/producers/caffeine-nirvana)
- Sample policy: 1kg per lot to qualified buyers; FOB Mangalore; CIF available
- Primary contact: danish@caffeinenirvana.co
- Response time: 24 hours
